scripts.start: AGENTS=${AGENTS:-3}; export NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096'; npm run package && killall holochain lair-keystore 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf .hc /tmp/hc-spin* 2>/dev/null; hc-spin -n $AGENTS --network-seed ping2pong_dev workdir/ping2pong.webhapp
scripts.network:tauri: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=$(get-port) concurrently "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm run launch:tauri" "holochain-playground"
scripts.launch:tauri: concurrently "hc run-local-services" "echo pass | RUST_LOG=warn hc launch --piped -n $AGENTS workdir/ping2pong.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT"
scripts.package: export NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096'; npm run build:happ && npm run package --workspace ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
